notes: A rate paid is read on chain over a past window. Past rates do not promise future rates.

facts.what: who can put money in: anyone with a wallet, or a KYC, allowlist or country limit
facts.text_as_published: Anyone with a wallet. The contract has no KYC, allowlist or country check.

facts.what: whether anyone can freeze or block a holder, and who
facts.text_as_published: No freeze of one holder's position in Aave. Aave's emergency admin can pause the whole market, which stops withdrawals. Circle can block an address from moving USDC.

facts.what: how a holder gets out, and any wait, cooldown or queue
facts.text_as_published: No wait or queue. You can withdraw what is not lent out to borrowers.

facts.what: the cut taken from the yield
facts.text_as_published: Aave keeps 10% of the interest borrowers pay (its reserve factor, read on chain on November 26, 2026).

read_me: The three rates are what the product paid over the last 7, 30 and 90 days, as yearly rates in percent.
A rate is null when it is not known. It is never zero.
read_on is the day of the reading and block the block it was read at. read_on can be older than the data day when that day's reading failed.
A fact shows its answer and its sources once a person has checked it against them. Until then it reads being checked, with no answer and no link.

check_states.confirmed: a person has checked the fact against its sources, so its answer and sources are shown
check_states.being_checked: a person has not checked it yet, so no answer and no source is shown
